recommended_split.policy: Whole collection days in chronological order, all rows of each sample together. Dataset has one row per sample. Fit all transforms on training only. Require both classes per partition; stop if unsupported.
recommended_split.rationale: Later collection-period holdout probes within-2024 drift without analytical sample overlap. All labels released together: this is retrospective temporal validation, not evidence a model could be trained during 2024. No result availability at earlier training boundaries is claimed.
recommended_split.secondary: GROUPED sample holdout for within-cohort comparison; GEOGRAPHIC only after source location semantics reviewed. No facility IDs; cannot prove lot/farm independence.

unit_of_observation: One unambiguous original imidacloprid analytical result for one PDP 2024 sample; at most one row per sample.
